hook.say: America's ten tallest mountains, ranked. Every single one is in Alaska!

outro.say: Which one would you climb? Comment below!

items.name: Mount Hunter
items.say: Number ten: Mount Hunter, Denali's fierce little neighbor. 14573 feet.
items.cap: Number ten: Mount Hunter, Denali's fierce little neighbor. 14,573 feet.

items.name: Mount Bear
items.say: Nine: Mount Bear, just four miles from Canada. 14831 feet.
items.cap: Nine: Mount Bear, just four miles from Canada. 14,831 feet.

items.name: Mount Hubbard
items.say: Eight: Mount Hubbard, shared with the Yukon. 14951 feet.
items.cap: Eight: Mount Hubbard, shared with the Yukon. 14,951 feet.

items.name: Mt. Fairweather
items.say: Seven: Mount Fairweather, rising straight from the Pacific coast. 15325 feet.
items.cap: Seven: Mount Fairweather, rising straight from the Pacific coast. 15,325 feet.

items.name: Mount Sanford
items.say: Six: Mount Sanford, a giant shield volcano. 16237 feet.
items.cap: Six: Mount Sanford, a giant shield volcano. 16,237 feet.

items.name: Mount Blackburn
items.say: Five: Mount Blackburn, king of the Wrangle Mountains. 16390 feet.
items.cap: Five: Mount Blackburn, king of the Wrangell Mountains. 16,390 feet.

items.name: Mount Bona
items.say: Four: Mount Bona, the highest volcano in the country. 16550 feet.
items.cap: Four: Mount Bona, the highest volcano in the country. 16,550 feet.

items.name: Mount Foraker
items.say: Three: Mount Forakker, known as Denali's wife. 17400 feet.
items.cap: Three: Mount Foraker, known as Denali's wife. 17,400 feet.

items.name: Mt. Saint Elias
items.say: Two: Mount Saint Elias, second highest in Canada too. 18009 feet.
items.cap: Two: Mount Saint Elias, second highest in Canada too. 18,009 feet.

items.name: Denali
items.say: And number one: Denali! 20310 feet, the roof of North America.
items.cap: And number one: Denali! 20,310 feet, the roof of North America.
